title: Factorized task x layer x position Mirror codes
hypothesis: Factorized task, layer, and adapter-position Mirror scalars composed through a shared basis will reconstruct held-out combinations with no more than 10% NRMSE penalty vs a full HyperFormer MLP and <=60% of its actual N=96 payload.
physical_object: one shared 2x2 adapter offset basis and intercept
mirror_coordinate: three learned categorical scalar codes m_task, m_layer, m_position, composed by product
logical_multiplicity: task x layer x position adapter combinations
controls: HyperFormer MLP over concatenated one-hot task/layer/position IDs
ordinary rank-one CP factorization with same scalar factor widths

task.teacher: A0 + (u_task*v_layer*w_position) B; all factors and basis vary by world

development.selection: choose Mirror update count using held-out combination NRMSE

success_gate: Every fresh world: Mirror held-out NRMSE <=1.10x HyperFormer and N96 payload <=60% HyperFormer; report equivalence or dominance by ordinary CP factorization.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/bytes, ordinary CP matches it at equal bytes, or held-out factor combinations fail.
boundaries: Synthetic low-rank tensor interaction only; not a natural adapter task.
The product factorization has a generic CP equivalent; no Mirror-specific claim if that control matches.
Factor indices and code tables are paid in serialized payload.
amendment_A1: Initial fresh results are retained as exploratory. The factor embedding optimizer initialization was not explicitly keyed to world/seed, so seed labels did not define reproducible per-run initial states. Added deterministic world/seed initialization, reran the frozen development update sweep, and fixed A1 before opening replacement worlds.
